screen.description: The 1.8 Battle Royale ESC / pause menu. MainMenu_C is the single "main menu" overlay used in the lobby (opened from the TopBar hamburger button) and in-game: Escape -> AthenaHUD.HandleCursorModeChanged -> TopBar.ForceMenuOpen -> TopBar (BackgroundBlur 16 + Border_ShellUberBG backdrop + 92-unit spacer) -> MainMenu. See reports/menu-hosts.json.

labelLogic.note: BR (Athena) branch = GetSubGame() == 1 (the second SubGame compare of GetLeaveActionText jumps to the block with no outpost logic): "Leave Match" while IsConsideredInGame() (= IsInLobby || IsInZone), otherwise "Leave Party". SubGame 0/2 are Save the World style (Leave Mission/Storm Shield/with Party). The SubGame==1 -> Athena mapping is consistent across MainMenu.ConfigureSubGameWidgets, TopBar.ConfigureVisibleItemsForSubGame and LeaveButton but the enum names are not serialized.

visibilityLogic.note: LeaveButton fires Update Visibility(IsConsideredInGame() || NumPlayersInLocalParty > 1); MainMenu binds it to LeaveButton.SetVisibility(true -> SelfHitTestInvisible(4), false -> Collapsed(1))
